[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Zolghast''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Zolghast was the commander of Separatist forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]] and he based himself in a secret bunker that was located in the world's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city, [[Tirahnn (city)|Tirahnn]]. He was assigned two [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] bodyguards to protect him and also kept a [[Porax-38 starfighter]], as his personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] planned to recapture the planet, they sent a team of agents there, to gain control of a planetary [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]]. Zolghast was the only person who had the firing codes for the cannon, so the agents infiltrated his bunker and captured him. Shortly afterward, the Republic forces began their main [[Battle of Tirahnn (Clone Wars)|attack]] and a team of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] was sent to collect Zolghast, so that he could be transported to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Solidarity (Venator-class)|''Solidarity'']].

The Separatists sent the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Braxus Lyn]] to free Zolghast and transport him away from the battle zone. Lyn disguised herself as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ezar Elasra]], allowing her to take custody of the Zygerrian. She then escorted him to a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] and began preparing it, so that they could leave the planet. However, before they could leave, they were attacked by the Republic agents, who attempted to recapture Zolghast.<ref name="GAW" />
